guarantees.text: `v.bytes(8)` on a string requires exactly 8 bytes.
`v.bytes(8)` reports an issue for a string whose byte count is not 8, using `message` as the error message when given.
`v.empty()` on a string accepts only the empty string "".
`v.empty()` on an array accepts only an array with no items.
`v.empty()` reports an issue for a non-empty string or array, using `message` as the error message when given.

guarantees.text: `v.length(8)` on a string requires a length of 8 UTF-16 code units.
`v.length(100)` on an array requires exactly 100 items.
`v.length(8)` reports an issue for a string whose length is not 8, using `message` as the error message when given.

guarantees.text: `v.maxLength(32)` on a string measures its length in UTF-16 code units and allows a length of at most 32.
`v.maxLength(5)` on an array counts the items and allows at most 5 items.
`v.maxLength(32)` reports an issue for a string longer than 32 UTF-16 code units, using `message` as the error message when given.

guarantees.text: `v.maxValue(100)` on a number allows a value of at most 100, that is it must not exceed 100.
`v.maxValue(100)` reports an issue for a number above 100, using `message` as the error message when given.

guarantees.text: `v.minBytes(64)` on a string requires a minimum of 64 bytes.
`v.minBytes(64)` reports an issue for a string with fewer than 64 bytes, using `message` as the error message when given.

guarantees.text: `v.minLength(3)` on a string measures its length like JavaScript's `value.length` (UTF-16 code units) and requires a length of at least 3.
`v.minLength(5)` on an array counts the items and requires at least 5 items.
`v.minLength(3)` reports an issue for a string with fewer than 3 UTF-16 code units, using `message` as the error message when given.

>

guarantees.text: `v.minValue(100)` on a number requires a value of at least 100.
`v.minValue(100)` reports an issue for a number below 100, using `message` as the error message when given.

guarantees.text: `v.multipleOf(2)` on a number accepts even numbers.
`v.multipleOf(2)` reports an issue for an odd number, using `message` as the error message when given.
`v.nonEmpty()` on a string requires at least one character.
`v.nonEmpty()` on an array requires at least one item.
`v.nonEmpty()` reports an issue for an empty string or an empty array, using `message` as the error message when given.

guarantees.text: `v.notLength(8)` on a string accepts any length other than 8.
`v.notLength(10)` on an array accepts any item count other than 10.
`v.notLength(8)` reports an issue for a string of length 8, using `message` as the error message when given.

units.summary: Creates a not value validation action.
units.returns:
NotValueAction<
  ValueInput,
  ValueInput,
  ErrorMessage<NotValueIssue<ValueInput, ValueInput>> | undefined
>

guarantees.text: `v.notValue(100)` on a number accepts every value that is more or less than 100.
`v.notValue(100)` reports an issue for the number 100, using `message` as the error message when given.

units.returns:
ValueAction<
  ValueInput,
  ValueInput,
  ErrorMessage<ValueIssue<ValueInput, ValueInput>> | undefined
>

guarantees.text: `v.value(100)` on a number requires the value to be 100.
`v.value(100)` reports an issue for a number other than 100, using `message` as the error message when given.
`v.value` does not change the type of the pipeline.
